summary: Iteration 35 — Cloudinary integration + Files module backend & frontend verification. All 15 backend tests passed (POST/DELETE /api/uploads, /api/files CRUD, RBAC, legacy /api/upload + /api/public/upload now return Cloudinary URLs, 25MB max constant, idempotent delete). Frontend smoke test on /files passed: login → page renders → file picker → metadata modal → upload to Cloudinary → grid updates → hover reveals open/delete actions. Image card shows thumbnail; doc card shows icon. New TEST_e2e_marsol file uploaded via UI was confirmed in grid, then cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~4579 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (uploads_router.py, files_router.py, etc.) for maintainability.

delete_uploaded_asset returns 404 when Cloudinary destroy returns non-ok. For idempotency on duplicate delete this is acceptable, but consider returning 200 {ok:false} so callers can distinguish 'already gone' from real errors.

create_file accepts arbitrary url/public_id from the client (no validation that it actually exists in Cloudinary or matches the cloud_name). A malicious authenticated user could persist external URLs. Consider validating the domain prefix res.cloudinary.com/ddyysroag/.
/api/upload (legacy) silently succeeds when MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES exceeded — wait, it does enforce 413. OK.
cloudinary_service.delete_asset swallows exceptions and returns False — the 404 path is correct, but real network errors are also masked as 'not found'. Consider distinguishing.

RBAC: /api/uploads (POST/DELETE) only requires get_current_user (any authenticated user can upload). Consider scoping by folder (e.g., marsol/companies → companies:write, marsol/employees → hr:write) to prevent abuse.
test_credentials: settings@marsol.az / marsol123 (admin); satis@marsol.az / marsol123 (Satış meneceri — files:read only). Login response key: access_token.
seed_data_creation: Test created and self-cleaned up: TEST_e2e_marsol via UI, several TEST_marsol_* via pytest (cleaned up in fixtures).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cloudinary cloud=ddyysroag is fully wired and active. All uploads land at https://res.cloudinary.com/ddyysroag/{image|raw|video}/upload/.../marsol/{files|companies|employees|projects}/.... Legacy /api/upload now returns Cloudinary URL (companies/HR/settings benefit transparently). Files page UI works end-to-end. RBAC: admin has full files:write, Satış meneceri has files:read only (POST/DELETE /api/files → 403 — verified). 13 tests cover happy paths + RBAC + edge cases.
